control_flow: stopAtWall: if no obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: Stop before a wall ahead without bumping into it.

branches.outcome: no obstacle is ahead: the robot stops
an obstacle is ahead: the robot calls followLine
no black: the robot curves right
